watches.description: Lacquer Arctic White dial Polished custom applied indices and faceted hands Bi-directional Worldtime bezel (Ceramic + Stainless Steel) In-house decorated and regulated Miyota 9075 True GMT movement Grade X1 Swiss Super-LumiNova BGW-9 Luminecent Designed for the World Traveler Standing among the giants at the 2025 GPHG in Geneva was a huge honor for Alcadus. It was validation that even a small, independent brand can compete on the world stage. The Voyager Worldtimer GMT is designed for the modern adventurer, featuring a sleek 39mm 316L stainless steel case that balances presence with wearability. With a 45.5mm lug-to-lug length and a thickness of 12.5mm, it strikes the perfect balance between elegance and practicality. The case sides feature a vertical brushed finish, while the lugs are adorned with a circular brushed texture, creating a harmonious contrast. A polished tapered chamfer along the lug shoulder enhances the watch’s sophistication, adding an extra level of detail to its classic, timeless design The dial is adorned with custom polished applied indices and faceted handsets, ensuring legibility and an elevated aesthetic. Pops of yellow on the GMT hand and seconds hand add a dynamic touch, subtly evoking the spirit of exploration. The watch incorporates a 24-hour GMT rehaut/chapter ring for tracking a second time zone, complemented by a black minutes track with yellow accents on a white background, providing clear functionality with a bold design flair. Lustrous Lacquered Dial A lacquered dial is a sophisticated and visually captivating feature in watchmaking, offering a high-gloss finish that resembles the appearance of enamel dials. To produce a lacquered dial, several thin layers of lacquer (or enamel paint) are spray-painted evenly onto a brass base dial and then fired in a kiln . Once the firing is complete, each dial undergoes a stringent quality control process. Any dial with imperfections, such as uneven surfaces or blemishes, is discarded to maintain the highest standard. The final step involves hand-polishing each dial until the dial looks like liquid ink with a mirror-like depth. Subtle Yet Impactful Features​ A hallmark of distinction across all ALCADUS models, the Voyager Worldtimer GMT proudly boasts box-shaped crystals that extend beyond the case edge. Moreover, our sapphire crystal undergoes a meticulous process, receiving 5 layers of Anti-Reflective coating on its inner side to enhance clarity and legibility. This thoughtful treatment ensures optimal visibility without compromising its integrity, as applying the coating to both sides can risk scratching. The finely knurled bezel, coupled with ceramic and stainless steel bezel inserts, adds a tactile and visually striking element. Moreover, your Voyager Worldtimer GMT is fortified with a high-tech scratch-resistant coating, boasting a remarkable hardness of 800 HV —four times that of uncoated stainless steel. This ensures enduring wear, allowing you to enjoy your timepiece for years to come. Bi-Directional Worldtime Bezel The Voyager Worldtimer GMT features a meticulously crafted bi-directional bezel engraved with 24 cities, each representing a different time zone. Daylight saving time is also accounted for, with a helpful arrow next to the city to indicate the adjustment. The bezel combines two distinct materials – the outer city ring is crafted from scratch-resistant ceramic, engraved with precision and filled with Super-LumiNova for glowing readability in low light. The inner city ring is engraved on stainless steel, adding contrast to the design. At the Kuala Lumpur location, where Alcadus Watches is proudly based, the lume pip marks the city’s position on the bezel, offering both a functional and symbolic feature for the wearer. watches.description: The Guilloché MOP Series We took natural Mother-of-Pearl and combined its organic iridescence with a technical, high-precision finish to catch the light from every single angle. Engineering Character: The Off-Center Pattern Unlike traditional guilloché that radiates from the center of the dials, we’ve designed these patterns to be off-centered . The focal point of the design begins at the small seconds sub-dial at the 9 o’clock position . To achieve this level of geometric complexity and crispness on such a delicate material, the patterns are precisely CNC-machined . This modern approach allows us to create deep, sharp ridges that catch the light in ways a traditional rose engine cannot, giving the dial a unique, modern-vintage character that shifts with every movement of your wrist. Graphite MOP For the Graphite Mother-of-Pearl , we wanted to explore the darker, more architectural side of Mother-of-Pearl. By tinting the shell in a smoky grey, we’ve created a “stealth” aesthetic that feels incredibly modern. At first glance, it appears as a dark, monochromatic charcoal, but as the light hits the off-centered guilloché pattern, it reveals a velvety, organic luster. The grey tint mutes the traditional “rainbow” flash of the shell, highlighting instead the sharp, three-dimensional geometry of the dial. It is subtle, masculine, and deeply understated. Micro-Rotor Movement The Quantra operates on an automatic movement featuring a micro-rotor. Its transparent case back and the positioning of the oscillating weight at the same level as other components unveil the watch’s inner workings, providing a captivating view of the gears in motion. The micro-rotor movement is regulated in-house to +/- 7 seconds and upgraded with blue screws and custom ALCADUS rotor. This thoughtful treatment ensures optimal visibility without compromising its integrity, as applying the coating to both sides can risk scratching. The watch case also features a 800 HV scratch-resistant coating and an anti-finger print coating to preserve the pristine beauty of your timepiece. watches.name: Quantra Gemstone – Yellow Mellite
watches.description: The Gemstone Series We worked with our dial makers to do something many said was impossible: slicing natural gemstones down to just 0.6mm . But the real challenge was the structural “sandwich” beneath it. Each dial is composed of: 0.6mm translucent natural gemstone. 0.2mm deep layer of Swiss BGW-9 Super-LumiNova. 0.2mm bronze base plate for rigidity. To keep this 1.0mm sandwich perfectly secure, all three layers are bolted together by two horizontal smooth domed-head bolts at the 3 and 9 o’clock positions. I specifically chose smooth domed heads instead of traditional screws for a reason: I didn’t want the “messy” look of misaligned screw slots. These custom bolts ensure the structure is rock-solid while keeping the visual focus entirely on the stone itself. Center 3-Hand Configuration To honor the purity of the stones, these models feature a clean center three-hand layout, allowing the light to travel across the dial without interruption. When you step into the dark, the 0.2mm layer of lume underneath shines through the 0.6mm gemstone, revealing the natural grain and “veins” of the stone. Yellow Mellite Commonly known as “Honey Stone,” Mellite is a rare organic mineral formed over millions of years. This gemstone is chemically an aluminum salt of mellitic acid, prized for its resinous luster and warm, honey-yellow to amber hues. Because the stone is naturally yellow, it acts as a high-pass filter for the blue-white lume, transforming it into an intense, radioactive green glow.
